summary:
I picked up from the committed work rather than starting again. The previous run had got further than planning/PARKED.md said: the engine, runner.js, worker.js, the service worker, the parser, the checker, serve.mjs, the site build, check.html, dev/setup.sh and the four Playwright test files were all committed. I checked that code instead of rewriting it and found nothing wrong. A clean `npm run build`, then `npm test` (18 parser tests and 54 engine and checker tests, 1 min 45 s), then `npm run check-lessons` on the fixture all pass.

What was missing, and what I added:
- **Docs:** the new `docs/PARSER.md` gives the parser's full output, field by field, and every error it reports. It also gives the shape of `lessons/index.json` and of the recorded outputs files. The new `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` covers the engine half: files, worker protocol, how cells become one program, Console shim, input, Stop, timeout, recycling, service worker, build, dev server, checker, tests, CI and the measured sizes and times.
- **Contract:** I rewrote `docs/ENGINE_API.md` so that it matches what `runner.js` really returns. It now covers the runner's options, the boot-failure codes and their sentences, the extra fields in the result, what values look like in the comparison, and the stats and dispose calls.
- **CI:** `.github/workflows/site.yml`.
- **Decisions:** entries 16–25 in DECISIONS.md.
- **Smaller changes:** a pointer in `docs/LESSON_FORMAT.md` to the new doc and to the practice page's own outputs file. The engine's project file now turns off CA1416, a warning that wrongly said `Console.SetIn` doesn't work in the browser. I marked the engine row done in `planning/PARKED.md`.

Measured on localhost with headless Chromium, 4 cores:
- `_framework` is 183 files: 42.6 MB raw, 15.7 MB gzip. A first visit downloads 15.1 MB in 185 requests.
- Boot takes about 0.9 s and the warm-up about 4 s, so the runner is ready about 5 s after the page loads.
- The first run after the warm-up takes 105–145 ms, and later runs 80–160 ms. Without the warm-up, the first run takes 3.2–3.4 s.
- A replacement worker (recycling) is ready 4.4 s after the memory threshold is passed, and the next run is no slower.
- The checker runs the fixture (2 pages, 23 runs) in 2.3 s, or 8 s in all including Chromium's start.
verified: Full build, engine and then site/: `npm run build` exits 0. It writes 183 files (42.57 MB) to engine/out/wwwroot/_framework and 194 files to site/, with no CA1416 warnings.
Parser unit tests and the vendor check: `npm test` reports 18 of 18 passing.

Engine and checker tests: `npm test` (node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/engine tests/tools) reports 54 of 54 passing in 1 min 45 s. They cover the eight traps; live input, a menu loop, end of input, Read and typed-ahead input; the three kinds of Stop, the timeout and the output cap; the five rules of the road, a class named Program, check mode, classify and the comparison with failing inputs; Model B across cells; the Console shim, ordinary Console calls, the en-IE culture (€12.50, 03/09/2026), Environment.Exit and a stack overflow; boot, recycling, boot failure (twice), a page without isolation, the service worker's cache-first second visit, check.html, and the checker on the fixture.
Checker on the fixture: `node tools/check-lessons.mjs --lessons tests/fixtures/lessons` gives 2 pages, 23 runs, no problems, in about 8 s (--jobs 1 is about the same).
Checker on the real lessons: `npm run check-lessons` exits 0 with 'No lessons in lessons/ yet: nothing to check.' It never reads drafts/.
The site build refuses a lesson with parser errors: buildSite on a bad lesson in the scratchpad gave 'refused: 2 problem(s) ... site/ was not written'.
Dev server: `node tools/serve.mjs --port 18931` served a .wasm file with application/wasm, gzip and max-age=600, and generated /lessons/index.json. I stopped it by its PID afterwards.

Setup script: `dev/setup.sh` exits 0 here, where the SDK is already in .dotnet/. The fresh-install path (dotnet-install.sh --jsonfile global.json into .dotnet/) is recorded as successful in .scratch/setup.log from the previous run.
Measurements come from my own Playwright scripts in the scratchpad (scratchpad/m/measure.mjs and cold.mjs). The figures are in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Sizes and times'.
The CI file's YAML parses (checked with js-yaml).
not_done: The CI workflow has not been run on GitHub; it can't be from here. Its steps are the same commands, run in the same order, that pass locally.
The measurements are from localhost, so they leave out network download time. Only Chromium was tested, because Firefox and Safari aren't available here.

Two differences from the earlier contract, both documented. First, the 'loading' status reports how many files have downloaded, not bytes, because that is what .NET 10 gives; ENGINE_API.md now says so. Second, check mode compiles a program cell as a program rather than as a library, because only a program may have top-level statements (decision 16).

The checker writes a separate outputs file for each practice page (<id>-practice.outputs.json). A shared cell whose program depends on the world is recorded once per world, under the key <cell id>@<world> (decision 25, docs/PARSER.md).
README.md is still two lines long. It wasn't part of this job, and CLAUDE.md sends readers to it for the overview.
The page UI (lesson page, notebook, course pages) is not built; that belongs to the next agent. drafts/ has uncommitted changes from the port agents, which I did not touch.
contract_changes: docs/ENGINE_API.md was rewritten to match runner.js exactly. The additions are the createRunner options table, the onStatus and ready() behaviour, and the 'loading' detail ({loaded, total, unit:'files'}: files, not bytes). The 'unavailable' detail is now documented as {reason, code, technical}, with a table of the five codes and their sentences and the rule that the page reloads once. Also new: the job queue; sendLine and endInput return values; the style chunk's colour names or null; and the note that output past the cap is hidden while the program runs on.

ENGINE_API.md also now describes the extra result fields the engine already returned: ran, files, replaced, diagnostics[].help, the shape of values entries (kind value, exception, compile-error or not-run, with message), and exception.trace and inner. Frames can have line null (stack overflow) and member null (top-level statements). It also covers timings.wallMs, inputWaitMs and inputLines, detail for host-error, how display writes each kind of value, inputs on a types or Main cell, the spare worker on restart, and runner.stats, memory() and dispose().
ENGINE_API.md now says check mode compiles a types cell as a library and a program cell as a program, because only a program may have top-level statements (decision 16).
docs/LESSON_FORMAT.md now points to docs/PARSER.md and lists lessons/<id>/<id>-practice.outputs.json, because a practice page is checked and recorded separately.
docs/PARSER.md is new. It describes the output of web/lesson/parse.js field by field, every check it makes, parseCourse, lessons/index.json and the recorded outputs file.
how_to_use:
In every shell: export PATH=/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/3a050fbb-a14a-5c05-b15a-309e2af64028/scratchpad/dotnet:$PATH DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1 DOTNET_ROOT=/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/3a050fbb-a14a-5c05-b15a-309e2af64028/scratchpad/dotnet. Note that tools/build-engine.mjs looks for dotnet in $DOTNET first, then .dotnet/ (which already holds 10.0.401 here), then PATH. On a fresh machine, run dev/setup.sh first.

Commands, all from /home/user/dewsharp:
- `npm run build`: the engine (`npm run build:engine`, about 45 s cold) and then site/ (`npm run build:site`).
- `npm test`: the parser tests and the vendor check, then the engine and checker tests in headless Chromium. They need a built engine and take about 2 minutes.
- `npm run check-lessons [-- --write] [-- --lessons dir] [-- --jobs n] [ids...]`. For example, `node tools/check-lessons.mjs --lessons tests/fixtures/lessons`.
- `npm run serve [-- --port N] [--isolate] [--site]`: serves from the sources. Pages are at /dev.html and /check.html.
- `npm run vendor`: after bumping js-yaml.

Gotchas:
- Pick a distinct --port for each agent. To stop a server, kill it by PID; pkill -f with a pattern that also appears in your own command kills your shell.
- The tests launch Playwright without a proxy, and use ?sw=off with a server started with --isolate.
- A lesson with a parser error stops both the site build and the checker.
- The page agent should read only docs/ENGINE_API.md and docs/PARSER.md (with web/engine/runner.js and web/lesson/parse.js), and load coi-serviceworker.js from each page's head.
